children: Ambarella Inc reported results for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $108.1M, up from $95.5M a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to ordinary shareholders of $6.7M, an improvement from a $20M loss in the prior-year quarter. Diluted loss per share narrowed to $(0.15) from $(0.47) a year ago.
Revenue: $108.1M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, compared with $95.5M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 13.2%.
Net income: Net loss attributable to ordinary shareholders of $6.7M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, improved from a $20.0M net loss in the year-ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: $(0.15) for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus $(0.47) in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue growth of 13.2% for the quarter and 14.9% year-to-date was driven by higher shipments of premium AI inference processors.
Sales remain concentrated through major ODMs, WT and Hakuto distributors, with IoT and automotive representing the largest end markets.
Product roadmap emphasizes AI/computer vision, CVflow third-generation SoCs and multimodal sensor fusion targeting automotive, IoT and robotics applications.
Board authorized a $50M share repurchase program covering July 1, 2026–June 30, 2027.
Volume production typically follows design wins by 12–18 months; inventory purchases increased amid supply-chain variability.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
